scope: Bound typed DXF GROUP vector staging and adopted-list transfer, including nested entity-handle work.

countedPayload: common table-entry name, reactors, pending references, XDATA and application-data nodes/payloads

behavior: Both const-vector staging and list adoption share record, aggregate-item and retained-byte estimation before copying, reserving or moving caller-owned groups.
The estimator accounts for dynamic common table-entry metadata, descriptions and member handle slots, and enforces the existing per-GROUP member ceiling.
Rejected input clears stale staged groups and planned identities, latches refusal before output initialization, and leaves rejected caller-owned vector/list data intact.
The const setter and list reserve path catch allocation failure; corrected setter/adoption retries work, and adopted values can be returned to their original list nodes.

The focused control accepts exactly 1,000,000 aggregate items and 64 MiB estimated logical payload, rejects one item or byte over, and verifies ASCII/Binary destination preservation and corrected write retry.

normalFocused.coverage: Existing GROUP adapter round-trip; exact/over item and byte boundaries; per-record member limit; stale-state clearing; rejected caller preservation for vector/list paths; injected const-copy and adoption-reserve allocation failure with retry/ownership return; ASCII/Binary destination preservation and corrected retry.

limitations: The byte estimator measures logical retained payload and container slots, not allocator capacity or process RSS.
These internal work/resource limits are not DXF format maxima or support claims.
The public setter/adoption implementation moved out of line; downstream consumers must relink. ABI and packaging qualification remain open under P8.
